evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present ActSpace-Bench, a benchmark of 994 questions across 234 exploration episodes in 72 real-scanned indoor scenes, where a model starts from a single view, navigates real captured frames, and must gather evidence before answering.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: To assess whether such exploration is purposeful, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol that fixes each model as the reasoner and compares its own exploration against a same-budget random walk and an oracle route, separating evidence seeking from spatial reasoning.
